sources.observation: White curtain walls and red-and-white towers frame stepped green roof ranges. A gold cupola rises among the four gray domes of the white cathedral.
Open arched stages, paired cornices and round framed panels distinguish the red-and-white tower. The green crown supports the narrow drum and gilded onion dome.

limitations: Roof pitches, carving, and building heights without mapped dimensions are estimated from reference photos. The curtain follows mapped walls, supplemented by a short inferred section on the east edge.
The two entrances retain exterior passage geometry. The model covers the named convent precinct and its perimeter, including its courtyard wings.
